steps.action: Unlock ladder: whack-a-mole driven by a compiled UI Automation sweeper (one cached call per sweep, each press on its own task)

artifact.source: main 5c048f4

steps.observed: The ladder fell from the sums to whack-a-mole as designed in three separate lockouts. The sweeper saw 13 of 14 moles and pressed each within about 200 ms of it appearing, but every press reached the application about two seconds later, because UI Automation Invoke blocks for roughly two seconds on a hidden desktop. All three rounds were graded lost and the ladder moved on to the clock, which is the specified behaviour for a lost round. The winning path is covered by the logic checks of the hit counter and the win ledger, not by this drive.
steps.result: pass (losing path); winning round not reachable with this input route
